rules.text: field goals only from the opponent's 51 or closer (a 69-yard attempt: the longest made in the training split plus 3 yards); no punt inside the opponent's 30; going for it is always allowed

support.note: The hard action rules and the support flags were added after the first Colab T4 run's test-season fourth-down results had been seen (see results/world_model/colab_t4_run_summary.md). They are a post hoc change to the planner, not part of that run's preregistered test plan.

diagnostic.method: first transition after the forced action, sampled draws_per_state times from each state's own context (the first step of a rollout); simulated rate = mean over states of the per-state share
diagnostic.caveat: empirical rates are for kicks and punts coaches chose to attempt; long attempts are selected (strong kickers, good conditions, but also end-of-half heaves), so a gap is not all simulator error

state.description: offense up 4, 4:00 left in the 4th quarter, 4th and 2 at its own 40
state.kept_from_real_game: possession, timeouts, pregame spread, opening receiver, all earlier records
state.limitation: earlier records are the real game's, so the history does not lead exactly to the edited score and clock
